days.title: High Peaks and Glaciers of Val Seriana
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pizzo Coca
stops.detail: The highest peak is Pizzo Coca (3,050 m), followed by Pizzo Redorta (3,038 m) and Punta di Scais (3,038 m).

stops.name: ghiacciaio del Trobio
stops.detail: The last surviving glacier on the Bergamo side of the Orobie is the Trobio glacier, located at the foot of the ridge connecting Monte Gleno to Pizzo dei Tre Confini.

days.title: Floral Trails and Waterfalls of the Valleys
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: cascate del torrente Vo
stops.detail: Equally numerous, but also of great environmental, economic, and tourist interest, are the waterfalls, including those of the Serio in Valbondione, the highest in Italy and second in Europe with a triple drop of 315 m to which a legend has been assigned, those of Val Sambuzza in Carona and the enchanting waterfalls of the Vo stream in the Val di Scalve.

stops.name: Presolana
stops.detail: The major peaks are Aralalta, Cancervo, Arera, Presolana, Ferrante, Alben.
